- Prosecutors have issued at least one subpoena
- Allegation: Clippers directed kickback from scoreboard contract (Intuit Dome) to Leonard via no-show endorsement deals worth millions
- NBA penalties already levied: Clippers surrendered 5 first-round picks (2029-33); Ballmer suspended 1 year; Gillian Zucker suspended 1 year; Lawrence Frank suspended 6 months; Leonard fined $700K; Dennis Robertson banned 5 years from NBA business
- Criminal investigation in "earliest stages" — unclear who faces scrutiny or if charges follow
- Kawhi's trade to Toronto is proceeding — Leonard himself not suspended
- SI.com notes a potential decision date has been revealed for the investigation (unspecified)
**Freshness:** Story first broke Sept. 10-11; DOJ probe is ongoing as of Sept. 12-13. FOLLOW UP from 09-12 coverage.
